main.title: How the event works for everyone
main.lead: Access, the code of conduct, what we keep about you and the terms of sale.

items: Step-free access to every room, with a lift to the gallery
Live captions and sign language on every talk
A hearing loop in both halls and a quiet room on each floor

items.text: Everyone at Interface Days is treated with respect. Harassment of any kind isn’t tolerated; tell any volunteer in a green shirt, or write to safety@example.com, and we act the same day.
We keep your name, email and ticket to run the event, and delete them six months after it ends. We never sell them.
Tickets are refunded in full until 1 February, and can be transferred to someone else at any time.
